title: Read Text from a File
question: Create a file containing Python is fun, read its contents, and print the text.
code:
with open("message.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write("Python is fun")

with open("message.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    content = file.read()
print(content)
explanation: Mode w writes the sample content and mode r reads it. Using with ensures each file is closed automatically.
